How I work

Design,
then ship

Step 1

Understand the product

Start with the people, the goal and the constraints, then map the system before drawing a single screen.

Step 2

Structure and flow

Turn the map into flows and wireframes that make the product easy to move through.

Step 3

Design with intent

Type, colour, spacing and motion chosen for the product, tuned until it looks good and reads clearly.

Step 4

Prototype with AI

Use AI workflows to get to a clickable prototype fast, so ideas get tested sooner.

Chopzi

Great food, delivered the simple way

Chopzi brings restaurants, food discovery, ordering and delivery tracking into one intuitive mobile app, built around the idea of "Great Food. Great Mood."

Food deliveryMobile appBranding
Role
Product designer
Platform
Mobile app
Scope
Moodboard, UI design, case study
Let's talk ↗

The challenge

Finding good food online can be frustrating. Users often struggle with discovering restaurants, comparing meals, navigating menus and completing orders smoothly.

How I worked

The project follows a structured, user-centered design process focused on understanding real user needs and reducing friction: starting with a moodboard to set the look and feel, then designing the interface, then documenting the work as a case study.

Chopzi brings restaurants, food discovery, ordering and delivery tracking into one platform. With organized categories, clear food details and a simplified checkout, ordering becomes easier.

1Moodboard
2UI Design
3Case Study

Outcome

A more convenient food ordering experience with improved navigation, accessible restaurant information, transparent pricing and seamless order tracking.

Users can now discover delicious meals, explore restaurants, place orders and track deliveries seamlessly, all through one simple food delivery experience.The goal of the design

Key screens

First impressions & onboarding. A branded splash screen, then three short slides: delicious meals at your fingertips, great food with faster delivery, and an experience that is more than food. Skip is always one tap away.

Account setup

A welcome screen leads into sign up, log in and phone verification. Google sign-up keeps it quick, and the six-digit code screen has a resend timer. Returning users get "Remember me" and a forgot-password link.

Home & discovery

Home greets the user, shows the delivery location, a search bar, a promo banner, quick food categories and popular meals. Search suggests what is popular nearby and what is trending, then filters results by meals or restaurants, with sort, price, rating and delivery options.

Restaurants & menus

Food categories lead to a restaurant page with a verified badge, rating, address, opening hours, delivery fee and delivery time. From there people browse the popular menu and open a dish for its details and a one-tap add.

The brand

Deep green and warm orange keep the app fresh and appetizing. A leaf in the mark signals freshness, and the line "Great Food. Great Mood." carries from the first screen to the last.
